plugins.description: The AutoBot-AI development workflow as 5 router meta-skills and 6 role agents (senior-developer, reviewer, planner, writer, sweeper, memory): lifecycle (session-lifecycle, implement, issue, commit, parallel, deploy, research, research-to-issues, adopt, batch-implement, drain, pr, github-cli), review (review, review-fleet, pre-merge-validate, code-reviewer, code-skeptic, security-auditor), audit (api-wiring-audit, dead-code-audit, dead-code-review), debug (debug-autobot), engineering (20 domain lenses).
